newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian state notes issue reaches 8.175 bln Bfr.
newsitem.headline: Belgian state notes issue reaches 8.175 bln Bfr.

text.p: The Treasury said in a statement on Wednesday that an issue of two state notes reached a final 8.175 billion francs at the end of Tuesday, the last day of subscriptions.
The ministry sold 1.825 billion francs of its revisable coupon 3/5/7-year notes and 6.350 billion of its five-year fixed coupon note, extendable to seven years.
Belgium hopes to raise 54 billion francs from four note issues planned for 1997/1998. Last year it raised 53 billion francs when it had targeted 80 billion.
The state notes are aimed at retail investors in direct competition with commercial banks' savings, or "cash", bonds, traditionally Belgium's most popular investment vehicle.
The popularity of cash bonds and notes has waned, however, against the background of low European interest rates.
